UserWorkspaceMeta.title: UserWorkspaceMeta
UserWorkspaceMeta.description: Private workspace metadata and active planner pointer isolated per authenticated user UID.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the owner.

email.description: Owner email address (PII, accessible only by the owner).

displayName.description: Display name shown in user menu.

hasOpenedApp.description: Whether the user has entered the planner workspace.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the workspace was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the workspace metadata was last updated.

UserPlanner.title: UserPlanner
UserPlanner.description: Individual MY DAY planner document containing schedules, todos, widgets, profile, and design settings.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the planner owner.

clientUpdatedAt.description: Client ISO timestamp for ordering and sync comparison.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the planner was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the planner was last saved.

data.description: Native Firestore map storing PlannerState (profile, design, notifications, categoryColors, monthlyBudget, widgets, customWidgets, schedules, todos, habits, ddays, focusEntries, expenses, notes, routines, checklists).

/users/{userId}.description: Private user workspace metadata and PII isolated strictly to the owning UID.

/users/{userId}/planners/{plannerId}.description: User-owned planners subcollection storing schedules, todos, widgets, and customization per planner.
